name: repolens
description: RepoLens — Understand the code before you change it.

scripts.setup:backend: cd backend && py -3.12 -m venv .venv && .\.venv\Scripts\python -m pip install -r requirements.txt
scripts.setup: npm run setup:backend && npm run setup:frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,magenta "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
scripts.check: npm run test:backend && cd frontend && npm run typecheck && npm run build
